verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ ਹਸਿਹਸਿ ਰਸਿਰਸਿ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau man kaale sap sir hasihas rasiras dhei na jaanai|

en.bdb: The snake has jewel in its head but it knows not to yield it willingly i.e. for getting it, it has to be killed..

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਤਨਿ ਜੀਵਦਿਆਂ ਕਿਉ ਕੋਈ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: jaan kathooree mirag tan jeevadhiaa(n) kiau koiee aanai|

en.bdb: Likewise how can the musk of a deer be obtained while it is alive.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਰਣਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਤਾਈਐ ਘੜੀਐ ਜਿਉਂ ਵਗਦੇ ਵਾਦਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: aaran lohaa taieeaai ghaReeaai jiau(n) vagadhe vaadhaanai|

en.bdb: The furnace, only heats the iron, but a desired and fixed shape is given to iron only by hammering it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਣੁ ਮਾਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੀਐ ਖਾਹਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sooran maaran saadheeaai khaeh salaeh purakh paravaanai|

en.bdb: Tuberous root yam becomes acceptable to the eaters and praised only after it has been refined with spices.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਚੂਨੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: paan supaaree kath mil choone ra(n)g sura(n)g sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: Betal leaf, betelnut, catechu and lime, when mixed together are identified by the beautiful colour of the mixture..

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਲਕੂਟੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਨਿ ਵੈਦ ਸੁਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: aaukhadh hovai kaalakooT maar jeevaalan vaidh sujaanai|

en.bdb: Poison in the hands of a physician becomes a medicine and animates the dead ones.
Unstable mercurial mind can be controlled by gurmukh alone.
